proposition: Akhlāṭī wrote to Ibn Turka addressing him as khalīlī ('my bosom companion') and as the leading luminary of his circle of brethren.

mediation.who: Akhlāṭī's letter preserved in the Munshaʾāt-i Turka
mediation.note: a letter of praise from a teacher to a disciple; it shows what Akhlāṭī wrote, not what he privately thought
